guide.title: Samuro's Overview
guide.text:
Samuro is a Melee Assassin who can Stealth and create Images of
himself on demand. His Mirror Images can confuse his enemies, causing them to
waste resources and cooldowns. Samuro is an excellent Offlaner.
With proper micro, his clones become a great nuisance for the
enemy team, while Samuro will shred through any target.

guide.title: Samuro's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Has very good DPS if he is free to hit
Has 2 different cleanses for DoTs or debuffs
Can tank many skillshots with clones
Can quickly clear Minions, Mercenaries or Monsters with Bladestorm
Has a very high skill ceiling
Can distract and confuse enemy Heroes with Illusion Master
Easily escape from any gank attempts
Has good self-sustain with Wind Walk
Weaknesses
Weak early game
Images can help enemies complete Quests
Vulnerable if Revealed
Vulnerable to peel and Knockbacks
Hard to play
No crowd control as a Bruiser

guide.title: Samuro's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Samuro synergizes with
Samuro does well with Heroes who can increase the stats of his Images, or that can heal
him from afar, like Malfurion and Deckard can. He also excels with Abathur,
the only thing better than Three Blade Style is
Six Blade Style.
You, improved.
Samuro is countered by
As Samuro has a hard time dealing with Knockbacks, Heroes like Lúcio
and E.T.C. can greatly reduce his effectiveness by pushing him away at every
possible aggression. He also suffers against Heroes that can easily kill his images,
like Jaina, Orphea or Cassia with Surge of Light.
Furthermore, Heroes that benefit from hitting clones can be a problem, such as
Medivh, or Diablo.
Stukov is exceptional against Samuro
because of Biotic Armor and Flailing Swipe,
which can greatly reduce Samuro's damage.

Samuro does very well on maps dependent on point capture, like Dragon Shire
or Braxis Holdout, because he can easily beat almost every hero after
Level 7. He is also very good on big maps where you need to channel objectives,
due to his great stall capabilities and great duel potential during them. Samuro
excels on maps with many different flank angles, where you can chase enemies or
hit them from behind during objectives.

guide.title: Samuro's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Clones' initial focus or movement can be controlled prior to Level 10, by using an Attack-Move command in the same moment they are created (This can be done by holding the button during the Mirror Image usage).
Use Mirror Image to tank tower shots while ganking, or to damage structures without a friendly minion wave.
Critical Strike resets your Basic Attacks; activate it immediately after delivering a Critical Strike for optimal effect.
Wind Walk can be used to quickly approach enemies, or to help you escape dangerous situations. Remember the cooldown starts ticking as soon as the ability is activated
Use Bladestorm to clear waves or to deal some AoE damage in fights, when enemy has no crowd controls available.
The Movement Speed provided by Image Transmission can be used not only to chase, but to dodge or to disengage from combat as well.
Activate Image Transmission to engage on a Hero near one of your Images, or to reposition to safety when you are in danger.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Samuro's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Samuro fits well into team compositions that need
a Melee Assassin and Offlaner,
but that also does not require extra peeling for
the most vulnerable Heroes in the team. Samuro can be a
liability against certain Heroes because his Images can help enemies to quickly
finish quests, or to enhance Healing dependent on hitting Heroes, like Malfurion
and Diablo have.
Despite all of Samuro's Weaknesses, an excellent player can have great impact
playing as him in all situations, due to his high skill ceiling.
With Illusion Master,
Samuro should be constantly harassing enemy backline, being
aware of when they spend their Abilities, to use Image Transmission
and kill them.

abilities.title: Samuro's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Clones' initial focus or movement can be controlled prior to Level 10, by using an Attack-Move command in the same moment they are created (This can be done by holding the button during the Mirror Image usage).
Use Mirror Image to tank tower shots while ganking, or to damage structures without a friendly minion wave.
Critical Strike resets your Basic Attacks; activate it immediately after delivering a Critical Strike for optimal effect.
Wind Walk can be used to quickly approach enemies, or to help you escape dangerous situations. Remember the cooldown starts ticking as soon as the ability is activated
Use Bladestorm to clear waves or to deal some AoE damage in fights, when enemy has no crowd controls available.
The Movement Speed provided by Image Transmission can be used not only to chase, but to dodge or to disengage from combat as well.
Activate Image Transmission to engage on a Hero near one of your Images, or to reposition to safety when you are in danger.

abilities.title: Image Transmission
abilities.text:
Image Transmission
(D)
Samuro
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Activate to switch places with a target Mirror Image, removing most negative effects from Samuro and all Mirror Images.
Advancing Strikes
Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.
Image Transmission can help Samuro to apply additional Basic Attacks onto
fleeing enemies, and to dodge enemy Abilities during confrontations. More
importantly, it can be activated to swap places with Images. This opens up
a variety of ways to deceive or outmaneuver your opponents.

abilities.title: Mirror Image
abilities.text:
Mirror Image
(Q)
Samuro
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Teleport a short distance in the direction of the mouse cursor, creating 2 Mirror Image in the opposite direction with as much Health as Samuro, each dealing 11 (+4% per level) damage with their Basic Attacks. Whenever an Image takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.
Mirror Images last for 8 seconds, and up to 2 Mirror Images can be active at a time. Each time they or Samuro hit an enemy Hero with their Basic Attack, their duration is extended by 1 second. Using Mirror Image removes most negative effects from Samuro.
Mirror Image is Samuro's most iconic Ability. As a squishy Melee Assassin,
he relies on these to take damage for him. Activating Mirror Image
will remove negative effects, move Samuro slightly in the direction of the
cursor, and create Images in the opposite direction. Images will spawn with
the same percentage of Health that Samuro has at the time of casting, meaning
that Images are most effective when cast while you are at full Health. The
Images can clear Minion waves, clear Mercenary Camps, and confuse and damage
enemy players. Images can soak many shots from enemy Structures, allowing Samuro
to siege without Minions, known as backdoor.
When using the Images against enemy Heroes, it is a good idea
to input as little as possible. Controlling Samuro in an intelligent manner
will give away the real Samuro; only do so when you are ready to disengage.
If you have Illusion Master, consider moving one of the Images away. This
will give you an exit via Image Transmission, or fool
enemies into thinking the Image is Samuro.

abilities.title: Critical Strike
abilities.text:
Critical Strike
(W)
Samuro
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Activate to cause Samuro and his Mirror Images next Basic Attack within 8 seconds to be a Critical Strike, dealing 50% additional damage. Stealth is not broken when activated.
Passive: Samuro and his Images also deal a Critical Strike every 4th Basic Attack.
Activating Critical Strike will reset the passive portion of the Ability,
so it is a good idea to use Critical Strike immediately after applying a
critical via the passive. Critical Strikes activated through the passive will
not expire, and can be saved for use at a later time. By quickly activating
Critical Strike after a passively triggered crit, you can hit an enemy with
2 Critical Strikes in quick succession. This can help to speed up Mercenary
Camps or other PvE activities, and can deal burst damage to enemy Heroes.

abilities.title: Wind Walk
abilities.text:
Wind Walk
(E)
Samuro
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Grant Samuro Stealth for up to 10 seconds or until he attacks, uses an Ability, or takes damage.
While Stealthed, Samuro heals for 2% of his maximum Health every second, his Movement Speed is increased by 20% and he can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.
Samuro is Unrevealable for the first 1 second of Wind Walk.
Wind Walk can be used to approach enemy Heroes or to help you
retreat. The Health Regeneration provided by it can be quite useful if you need to
double soak, by using it instead of mounting in rotations, you will
always be in a good state to duel whoever you are facing.
Since Wind Walk is your only way to self-sustain,
it should always be used when Samuro is not hitting anything. With proper use, Samuro will never have
to return to base.

abilities.title: Bladestorm
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Bladestorm
(R)
Samuro
Heroic
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.
Samuro can move during Bladestorm, and cancel it by reactivating the
Ability. Bladestorm greatly improves Samuro's waveclear.
Given it deals less single target damage than your Basic Attacks,
it should mostly be used to clear a wave, as it deals
enough area of effect damage to quickly kill all Minions.
It has higher range than your Basic Attacks, so it helps you to secure kills that
could otherwise be prevented by enemies moving outside of Melee range.
If an enemy is low on Health and you are able to get in range, this
Heroic will almost always result in a takedown. If you do not have
Mirror Image to self-cleanse a Blind,
Bladestorm will be a great way to keep dealing damage to your target.
Keep in mind that Samuro will be an easy target during that Heroic,
because enemies will instantly know that you are the real one and will be able to focus
you down.

abilities.title: Illusion Master
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Illusion Master
(R)
Samuro
Heroic
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%.
Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.
Illusion Master is a novel Heroic that is more of an
extra passive, rather than an actived one. Illusion Master will increase the
efficiency of your Mercenary clear, so if you are playing on a Map
where Mercenary Camps are very important (like Blackheart's Bay,) it can be a very strong
choice. If you want to try a challenging and unconventional approach focused on
cunning and subterfuge, try this Heroic out! Although powerful, this Talent
adds a layer of mechanical complexity; we recommend Illusion Master for players
who are already quite comfortable with Samuro's other mechanics.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Way of Illusion greatly increases Samuro's damage, but
only when the quest is completely done. It should be the pick in most of the games,
unless you will have a hard time stacking it, which will happen when facing Heroes
in lane that will not let you stack reliably, such as Fenix or Zeratul.
Way of the Blade increases Samuro's damage. It also increases the
damage of Mirror Images, because they will critically strike more often. Additionally,
Way of the Blade reduces the Physical Armor of Heroes that are hit by Critical
Strike. It will be better than Way of Illusion if you are facing targets with much Armor,
such as Garrosh, Deathwing or Cassia.
Way of the Wind gives Samuro more self-sustain and
greatly improved mobility that can
be used to approach enemies, to retreat, or to dodge harmful effects. While it does not
directly increase Samuro's damage, it enables him to be in melee range to deal
damage much more often. Besides that, it also greatly improves his macro,
since it increases his rotation speed. Furthermore, it allows him to
tank more damage in lane without having to take a Healing Fountain or to Hearthstone.
It is a great option for Players new to Samuro, since it
will allow them to engage, escape, and heal themselves much easier.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Mirage increases the survivability of Samuro and his Images by
allowing you to reduce the incoming Ability damage. This will also make
your Images harder to deal with for the enemy team, which can buy your team
time to rotate or escape. Mirage is recommended with Illusion Master, as it
makes your Images harder for the enemy team to clear. It should be the default option
for this tier, considering the Armor will also makes Images harder to distinguish.
One With The Wind greatly increases the survivability of Samuro and
his Images by allowing you to reduce all incoming damage at will. Unfortunately,
this Talent is much less versatile than the other 2 options, since it encourages
you to start a fight with Wind Walk. Mostly you want
to have Wind Walk ready, if you want to retreat or for some healing. It is still
a decent option when paired with other Wind Walk Talents.
Deflection can only reduce incoming Attack Damage, and only does
so while you are on the offensive. It is a good option against many Basic-Attack-reliant Heroes,
such as Illidan, Greymane, or Thrall.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Burning Blade increases the damage that your
Critical Strikes do, and also works on your Images. It also greatly improves
Samuro's waveclear. This is the default Talent for this tier, as, differently from its counterparts,
it does not need any conditions to increase Samuro's Damage. It also boost
his PvE capabilities, which is extremely useful considering Samuro
will be constantly clearing waves.
Phantom Pain can conditionally surpass Burning Blade's
damage, but is much less consistent. Burning Blade offers almost as much damage,
does so in an area of effect, and is not dependent on Images being active.
Crushing Blows offers the highest damage potential among
the options in this tier. However, it requires sustained combat to become effective,
making it challenging to maximize its value. This Talent is best suited for experienced
Samuro players who can survive long enough in teamfights to fully charge and utilize
its power. While risky, it can be highly rewarding when used properly.

If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
Bladestorm is a good Heroic that greatly improves
Samuro's waveclear. Given it deals less single-target
damage than your Basic Attacks, it should mostly be used to clear a wave, as it deals
enough area of effect damage to quickly kill all Minions.
It has better range than your Basic Attacks, so it helps you to secure kills that
could otherwise be prevented by enemies moving outside of Melee range.
If an enemy is low on Health and you are able to get in range, this
Heroic will almost always result in a takedown. If you do not have
Mirror Image to self-cleanse a Blind,
Bladestorm will be a great way to keep dealing damage to your target. However,
be aware that by using Bladestorm you will become an easy target, since it reveals
which Samuro is the real one.
Illusion Master is a novel Heroic that is more of an
extra passive, rather than an activated one. If you want to try a challenging
and unconventional approach focused on
cunning and subterfuge, try this Heroic out! Although powerful, this Talent
adds a layer of mechanical complexity; we recommend Illusion Master for players
who are already quite comfortable with Samuro's other mechanics.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Merciless Strikes is a good Talent when paired with
Burning Blade. If you have reliable sources of Slows
in your team, this Talent will greatly improve your effectiveness in fights.
Harsh Winds gives Samuro enough damage potential to kill many
Heroes in the game by himself. Harsh Winds greatly increases Samuro's burst damage.
This makes hit and run harassment much more meaningful, often forcing enemies to
retreat from the battlefield completely. It also increases the damage dealt by
Bladestorm, and is the standard pick with it.
Press the Attack synergizes exceptionally well with
Crushing Blows, enhancing your damage output and accelerating
its application. To maximize this Talent's effectiveness, Samuro can initially
target more durable Heroes to build up attack speed, then switch focus to a
priority target for devastating burst damage.
This strategy allows for efficient damage ramp-up and strategic target
selection in teamfights.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Dance Of Death can be decent if you get to reset Bladestorm
often with it, but it is not hard to interrupt it
with Stuns or Silences. For those reasons,
we do not recommend Dance of Death with Bladestorm.
Three Blade Style is a good choice to destroy Structures
or to pressure the opposing team into reacting in many different points at the same time,
as it greatly increases Image durability and duration. Because
you will be able to spread the Illusions out further, you will be capable of
even more complex and mind-bending plays!
Several of the Talents that affect Wind Walk cause
unique effects, almost like an Ability. Wind Strider is
an amazing Talent because it allows you to activate these effects much more
often. If you have two or more Talents invested into Wind Walk, this is almost
irrefutably the best choice at Level 20.
Blademaster's Pursuit is primarily useful for the
increased Movement Speed. This Talent is a good alternative to Three Blade Style
if you are looking for a last fight, since it will add more than the other options.
